10	    snapshot: CodexRateLimitSnapshot | null
11	    stale: boolean
12	}
13	
14	const INITIAL_STATE: CodexRateLimitState = { receivedAt: null, snapshot: null, stale: false }
15	const UNIX_MILLISECONDS_THRESHOLD = 1_000_000_000_000
16	
17	function resetTimeMilliseconds(resetTime: number) {
18	    return resetTime < UNIX_MILLISECONDS_THRESHOLD ? resetTime * 1000 : resetTime
19	}
20	
21	function firstResetTime(snapshot: CodexRateLimitSnapshot) {
22	    const resetTimes = snapshot.buckets.flatMap(({ primary, secondary }) => (
23	        [primary?.resetsAt, secondary?.resetsAt]
24	            .filter((resetTime): resetTime is number => resetTime !== null && resetTime !== undefined)
25	            .map(resetTimeMilliseconds)
26	    ))
27	
28	    return resetTimes.length > 0 ? Math.min(...resetTimes) : null
29	}
30	
31	function validSnapshot(snapshot: CodexRateLimitSnapshot) {
32	    return Number.isFinite(snapshot.observedAt)
33	        && (!snapshot.available || snapshot.buckets.length > 0)
34	        && snapshot.buckets.every(({ primary, secondary }) => (
35	            (!primary || Number.isFinite(primary.usedPercent))
36	            && (!secondary || Number.isFinite(secondary.usedPercent))
37	        ))
38	}

40	/** Owns current account-wide Codex rate limits for this renderer process only. */

43	    private expirationTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null

45	    private unsubscribeConnection: (() => void) | null = null

52

60

94	1. A periodic out-of-band `echo /usage | claude` spawn parses both windows (`Current session:` → `five_hour`, `Current week (all models):` → `weekly`) into a normalized snapshot with `usedPercent` (integer) and `resetsAt` (unix ms, converted from the localized datetime + tz).
95	2. The snapshot reaches the renderer via `window.md2ClaudeRuntime` with `observedAt`, `resetsAt`, window identifier, and `usedPercent`.
96	3. An older observation (`observedAt` earlier than the current snapshot) is ignored; the newest wins.
97	4. Malformed/partial `/usage` output is rejected by normalization and never crashes the poll or the renderer.

102	6. Clicking/tapping the indicator opens a claude-specific details popover listing each reported window with its reset time and percent.
103	7. Indicator shows "Claude N% used", warns as a limit is approached and shows error styling when a limit is reached.
104	8. When no claude snapshot exists, or the snapshot is stale (its earliest `resetsAt` has passed), the claude indicator renders nothing — no stale numbers shown.
